title: Webb County Judge Tijerina Honored for 12 Years With Regional Planning Group
excerpt: The Laredo & Webb County Area Metropolitan Planning Organization honored Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina for 12 years of service, presenting him with a plaque at a special meeting at Laredo City Hall as his term as county judge nears its end.
content:
The Laredo & Webb County Area Metropolitan Planning Organization honored Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina for 12 years of service with the regional planning group, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The organization's Policy Committee presented Tijerina with a plaque at a special meeting on Nov. 18 at Laredo City Hall.

Tijerina's term as county judge ends Dec. 31. He did not seek reelection, instead running as the Republican nominee for Texas' 28th Congressional District, a race U.S. Rep. Henry Cuellar won on Nov. 3.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 24, 2026.
